question: If 38% of first number is equal to two-sevenths of second number, what is the ratio of first number to the second number?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the first number be A and the second number be B.

Given, 38% of A = ²/₇ of B

⇒ ¹⁹/₅₀ × A = ²/₇ × B

⇒ A : B = (2 × 50) : (7 × 19)

⇒ A : B = 100 : 133

**∴ The correct answer is 100 : 133.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

38% of the first number is equal to two-sevenths of the second number.

 
 
 First Number (A)
 38 parts
 Total = 100 parts

 
 
 Second Number (B)
 38 parts
 Total = 133 parts

 
• 
 
 =
 38% of A
 2/7 of B

 Ratio A : B = 100 : 133

**Calculations:**

Let the first number be A and the second number be B.

⇒ 38% of A = ²/₇ of B

⇒ (³⁸/₁₀₀) × A = (²/₇) × B

Simplifying the fraction on the left side,

⇒ (¹⁹/₅₀) × A = (²/₇) × B

Cross-multiplying to find the ratio A : B,

⇒ A/B = (²/₇) × (⁵⁰/₁₉)

⇒ A/B = (2 × 50) / (7 × 19)

⇒ A/B = 100 / 133

⇒ A : B = 100 : 133

**∴ The correct answer is 100 : 133.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio & Proportion

A ratio compares two quantities by division, written as a:b. If a:b = c:d, the relationship is called a proportion, where a×d = b×c.

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

To convert any percentage to a fraction, replace the % sign by dividing the value by 100 and simplifying (e.g., 38% = 38/100 = 19/50).

Cross-Multiplication

When moving a fraction to the opposite side of an equation, you multiply by its reciprocal. Example: If (x/y) × A = B, then A = B × (y/x).
